datasets.name: ds_usage_daily
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily
  WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))
),
tgt AS (SELECT price_input pin, price_output pout, price_cache_read pcr, price_cache_write pcw
        FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_ref WHERE match_key = concat_ws('-', nullif(array_join(filter(split(lower(regexp_replace(trim(:param_sim_model), '[ ._]+', '-')),'-'), t -> NOT t rlike '^[0-9]+$'),'-'),''), nullif(array_join(filter(split(lower(regexp_replace(trim(:param_sim_model), '[ ._]+', '-')),'-'), t -> t rlike '^[0-9]+$'),'-'),''))),
daily_tok AS (
  SELECT event_date,
         SUM(GREATEST(input_tokens - cache_read_input_tokens - cache_creation_input_tokens, 0)) inp_pure,
         SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) cread, SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens) cwrite, SUM(output_tokens) outp
  FROM base GROUP BY event_date
),
daily_sim AS (
  SELECT d.event_date, (GREATEST(d.inp_pure - d.cread - d.cwrite, 0)*t.pin + d.cread*COALESCE(t.pcr,t.pin) + d.cwrite*COALESCE(t.pcw,t.pin) + d.outp*t.pout)/1e6 AS sim_cost
  FROM daily_tok d LEFT JOIN tgt t ON TRUE
)
SELECT b.event_date, b.destination_model,
       CAST(SUM(b.cost_usd) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd,
       SUM(b.total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
       CAST(MIN(s.sim_cost) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS sim_cost_usd
FROM base b JOIN daily_sim s ON b.event_date = s.event_date
GROUP BY b.event_date, b.destination_model
ORDER BY b.event_date

datasets.name: ds_kpis
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily
  WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))
),
tok AS (
  SELECT SUM(GREATEST(input_tokens - cache_read_input_tokens - cache_creation_input_tokens, 0)) AS inp_pure,
         SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) AS cread, SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens) AS cwrite,
         SUM(output_tokens) AS outp, CAST(SUM(cost_usd) AS DOUBLE) AS real_cost
  FROM base
),
tgt AS (SELECT price_input pin, price_output pout, price_cache_read pcr, price_cache_write pcw
        FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_ref WHERE match_key = concat_ws('-', nullif(array_join(filter(split(lower(regexp_replace(trim(:param_sim_model), '[ ._]+', '-')),'-'), t -> NOT t rlike '^[0-9]+$'),'-'),''), nullif(array_join(filter(split(lower(regexp_replace(trim(:param_sim_model), '[ ._]+', '-')),'-'), t -> t rlike '^[0-9]+$'),'-'),'')))
SELECT CAST(tok.real_cost AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS real_cost,
       CAST((GREATEST(tok.inp_pure - tok.cread - tok.cwrite, 0)*tgt.pin + tok.cread*COALESCE(tgt.pcr,tgt.pin) + tok.cwrite*COALESCE(tgt.pcw,tgt.pin) + tok.outp*tgt.pout)/1e6 AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS sim_cost,
       CAST((GREATEST(tok.inp_pure - tok.cread - tok.cwrite, 0)*tgt.pin + tok.cread*COALESCE(tgt.pcr,tgt.pin) + tok.cwrite*COALESCE(tgt.pcw,tgt.pin) + tok.outp*tgt.pout)/1e6 - tok.real_cost AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS savings
FROM tok LEFT JOIN tgt ON TRUE

datasets.name: ds_compare
datasets.displayName: Comparativo do período: real vs. modelo único
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily
  WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))
),
tok AS (
  SELECT SUM(GREATEST(input_tokens - cache_read_input_tokens - cache_creation_input_tokens, 0)) AS inp_pure,
         SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) AS cread, SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens) AS cwrite,
         SUM(output_tokens) AS outp, CAST(SUM(cost_usd) AS DOUBLE) AS real_cost
  FROM base
),
cmp_keys AS (SELECT concat_ws('-', nullif(array_join(filter(split(lower(regexp_replace(trim(m), '[ ._]+', '-')),'-'), t -> NOT t rlike '^[0-9]+$'),'-'),''), nullif(array_join(filter(split(lower(regexp_replace(trim(m), '[ ._]+', '-')),'-'), t -> t rlike '^[0-9]+$'),'-'),'')) AS mk FROM (SELECT explode(:param_compare_models) AS m)),
ref AS (SELECT match_key, model, price_input, price_output, price_cache_read, price_cache_write
        FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_ref WHERE match_key IN (SELECT mk FROM cmp_keys))
SELECT '0 · Mix atual (real Databricks)' AS scenario, CAST((SELECT real_cost FROM tok) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd
UNION ALL
SELECT concat('Só ', r.model) AS scenario,
       CAST((GREATEST(t.inp_pure - t.cread - t.cwrite, 0)*r.price_input + t.cread*COALESCE(r.price_cache_read,r.price_input) + t.cwrite*COALESCE(r.price_cache_write,r.price_input) + t.outp*r.price_output)/1e6 AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd
FROM ref r CROSS JOIN tok t
ORDER BY scenario

datasets.name: ds_harness
queryLines: WITH scoped AS (   SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily   WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) ), base AS (   SELECT event_date, workspace_id, endpoint_name, destination_model, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd   FROM scoped   WHERE event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max     AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ), harness AS (   SELECT DATE(event_time) AS event_date, CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, endpoint_name,          LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(destination_model, '[ .]+', '-')) AS destination_model,          CASE            WHEN url LIKE '%/cursor/v1/chat/completions%' THEN 'Cursor'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE '%claude%' THEN 'Claude Code'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE '%gemini%' THEN 'Gemini CLI'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE '%codex%' THEN 'Codex CLI'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE '%opencode%' THEN 'OpenCode'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE 'pi/%' THEN 'Pi'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE '%copilot%' THEN 'Github Copilot'            ELSE 'Outros / API direta'          END AS harness,          SUM(total_tokens) AS htok   FROM system.ai_gateway.usage   WHERE destination_model IS NOT NULL     AND (invocation_metadata.source != 'AI_QUERY' OR invocation_metadata.source IS NULL)     AND (service_type != 'MCP_SERVICE' OR service_type IS NULL)   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ), grp AS (   SELECT event_date, workspace_id, endpoint_name, destination_model, SUM(htok) AS mtok   FROM harness GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) SELECT h.harness,        CAST(SUM(CAST(base.cost_usd AS DOUBLE) * h.htok / NULLIF(g.mtok, 0)) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd FROM base JOIN harness h ON base.event_date = h.event_date AND base.workspace_id = h.workspace_id   AND base.endpoint_name = h.endpoint_name AND base.destination_model = h.destination_model JOIN grp g ON base.event_date = g.event_date AND base.workspace_id = g.workspace_id   AND base.endpoint_name = g.endpoint_name AND base.destination_model = g.destination_model GROUP BY h.harness ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

datasets.name: ds_provider_sim
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_ref WHERE on_databricks),
base AS (
  SELECT destination_model, match_key, SUM(input_tokens) inp, SUM(output_tokens) outp,
         SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) cread, SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens) cwrite,
         CAST(SUM(cost_usd) AS DOUBLE) real_cost
  FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily
  WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ra AS (SELECT b.*, ref.intelligence ri FROM base b JOIN ref ON b.match_key = ref.match_key),
mix AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(real_cost) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) cost_usd FROM base),
cand AS (
  SELECT ra.match_key, ra.inp, ra.outp, ra.cread, ra.cwrite, ep.provider target_provider,
         ep.price_input pin, ep.price_output pout, ep.price_cache_read pcr, ep.price_cache_write pcw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.match_key, ep.provider ORDER BY ABS(ep.intelligence - ra.ri), ep.intelligence DESC) rn
  FROM ra JOIN ref ep ON TRUE
),
per_prov AS (
  SELECT concat('Só ', target_provider) scenario, target_provider,
         SUM((GREATEST(inp - cread - cwrite, 0)*pin + cread*COALESCE(pcr,pin) + cwrite*COALESCE(pcw,pin) + outp*pout)/1e6) cost_usd
  FROM cand WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY target_provider
)
SELECT '0 · Mix atual (real Databricks)' AS scenario, cost_usd FROM mix
UNION ALL
SELECT scenario, CAST(cost_usd AS DECIMAL(38,2)) FROM per_prov WHERE array_contains(:param_sim_providers, target_provider)
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

datasets.name: ds_provider_sim_stacked
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_ref WHERE on_databricks),
base AS (
  SELECT destination_model, match_key, SUM(input_tokens) inp, SUM(output_tokens) outp,
         SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) cread, SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens) cwrite,
         CAST(SUM(cost_usd) AS DOUBLE) real_cost
  FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily
  WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ra AS (SELECT b.*, ref.intelligence ri FROM base b JOIN ref ON b.match_key = ref.match_key),
base_named AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(r.model, b.destination_model) segment_model, CAST(SUM(b.real_cost) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) cost_usd
  FROM base b LEFT JOIN ref r ON b.match_key = r.match_key
  GROUP BY COALESCE(r.model, b.destination_model)
),
cand AS (
  SELECT ra.match_key, ra.inp, ra.outp, ra.cread, ra.cwrite, ep.provider target_provider, ep.model target_model,
         ep.price_input pin, ep.price_output pout, ep.price_cache_read pcr, ep.price_cache_write pcw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.match_key, ep.provider ORDER BY ABS(ep.intelligence - ra.ri), ep.intelligence DESC) rn
  FROM ra JOIN ref ep ON TRUE
),
per_prov AS (
  SELECT concat('Só ', target_provider) scenario, target_provider, target_model segment_model,
         SUM((GREATEST(inp - cread - cwrite, 0)*pin + cread*COALESCE(pcr,pin) + cwrite*COALESCE(pcw,pin) + outp*pout)/1e6) cost_usd
  FROM cand WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY target_provider, target_model
)
SELECT '0 · Mix atual (real Databricks)' AS scenario, segment_model, cost_usd FROM base_named
UNION ALL
SELECT scenario, segment_model, CAST(cost_usd AS DECIMAL(38,2)) FROM per_prov WHERE array_contains(:param_sim_providers, target_provider)
ORDER BY scenario, cost_usd DESC

datasets.name: ds_provider_kpis
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_ref WHERE on_databricks),
base AS (
  SELECT destination_model, match_key, SUM(input_tokens) inp, SUM(output_tokens) outp,
         SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) cread, SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens) cwrite,
         CAST(SUM(cost_usd) AS DOUBLE) real_cost
  FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily
  WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ra AS (SELECT b.*, ref.intelligence ri FROM base b JOIN ref ON b.match_key = ref.match_key),
real_tot AS (SELECT SUM(real_cost) real_cost FROM base),
equiv AS (
  SELECT match_key, pin, pout, pcr, pcw FROM (
    SELECT m.match_key, ep.price_input pin, ep.price_output pout, ep.price_cache_read pcr, ep.price_cache_write pcw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.match_key ORDER BY ABS(ep.intelligence - m.ri), ep.intelligence DESC) rn
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT match_key, ri FROM ra) m
    JOIN ref ep ON ep.provider = :param_sim_provider
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
sim AS (
  SELECT SUM((GREATEST(ra.inp - ra.cread - ra.cwrite, 0)*e.pin + ra.cread*COALESCE(e.pcr,e.pin) + ra.cwrite*COALESCE(e.pcw,e.pin) + ra.outp*e.pout)/1e6) sim_cost
  FROM ra JOIN equiv e USING (match_key)
)
SELECT CAST((SELECT real_cost FROM real_tot) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS real_cost,
       CAST((SELECT sim_cost FROM sim) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS sim_cost,
       CAST((SELECT sim_cost FROM sim) - (SELECT real_cost FROM real_tot) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS savings

datasets.name: ds_provider_daily
queryLines:
WITH ref AS (SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_ref WHERE on_databricks),
base AS (
  SELECT event_date, destination_model, match_key, SUM(input_tokens) inp, SUM(output_tokens) outp,
         SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) cread, SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens) cwrite,
         CAST(SUM(cost_usd) AS DOUBLE) real_cost
  FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily
  WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
ra AS (SELECT b.*, ref.intelligence ri FROM base b JOIN ref ON b.match_key = ref.match_key),
equiv AS (
  SELECT match_key, pin, pout, pcr, pcw FROM (
    SELECT m.match_key, ep.price_input pin, ep.price_output pout, ep.price_cache_read pcr, ep.price_cache_write pcw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.match_key ORDER BY ABS(ep.intelligence - m.ri), ep.intelligence DESC) rn
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT match_key, ri FROM ra) m
    JOIN ref ep ON ep.provider = :param_sim_provider
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
sim_dm AS (
  SELECT ra.event_date, SUM((GREATEST(ra.inp - ra.cread - ra.cwrite, 0)*e.pin + ra.cread*COALESCE(e.pcr,e.pin) + ra.cwrite*COALESCE(e.pcw,e.pin) + ra.outp*e.pout)/1e6) sc
  FROM ra JOIN equiv e USING (match_key) GROUP BY ra.event_date
)
SELECT b.event_date, b.destination_model,
       CAST(b.real_cost AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd,
       CAST(sd.sc AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS sim_cost_usd
FROM base b LEFT JOIN sim_dm sd ON b.event_date = sd.event_date
ORDER BY b.event_date

datasets.name: ds_cov_endpoints
queryLines:
WITH dbx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT endpoint_name, concat_ws('-', nullif(array_join(filter(split(lower(regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(endpoint_name, '^databricks-', '')), '[ ._]+', '-')),'-'), t -> NOT t rlike '^[0-9]+$'),'-'),''), nullif(array_join(filter(split(lower(regexp_replace(trim(regexp_replace(endpoint_name, '^databricks-', '')), '[ ._]+', '-')),'-'), t -> t rlike '^[0-9]+$'),'-'),'')) AS match_key
  FROM system.serving.served_entities
  WHERE task = 'llm/v1/chat' AND endpoint_delete_time IS NULL AND endpoint_name LIKE 'databricks-%'
)
SELECT endpoint_name, match_key
FROM dbx WHERE match_key NOT IN (SELECT match_key FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_aa_model_ref)
ORDER BY endpoint_name

datasets.name: ds_cov_usage
queryLines:
SELECT destination_model,
       CAST(SUM(cost_usd) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd,
       SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily
WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))
  AND match_key NOT IN (SELECT match_key FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_aa_model_ref)
GROUP BY destination_model
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
